# Name: # Custom partition table for this board's 4MB flash (see sdkconfig.defaults:
# CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHSIZE_4MB + CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_CUSTOM).
# Two OTA app slots (ota_0/ota_1) + otadata instead of a single "factory"
# image
Type: so a future update mechanism can write the new image to the

# Name: # INACTIVE slot and only switch esp_ota_set_boot_partition() over to it
# once that write verifies -- the currently-running image is never
# overwritten in place. No actual update-writing logic is implemented yet
# (no esp_https_ota/esp_ota_begin+write+end calls anywhere in this
# firmware) -- this is only the partition/Kconfig structure a future OTA
# client needs
# (CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE). The other half of the rollback
# contract -- confirming a booted image so the bootloader stops treating
# it as "pending verify" -- IS implemented: see
# confirm_app_if_pending_verify() in main/poe_luminaire_main.c.
# (2026-08-20: briefly reverted to a single-"factory" layout to A/B-test
# whether the OTA partition table was behind a slow/flaky boot -- it
# wasn't
Type: the same behavior persisted with the old layout too

# Name: # back to the OTA-ready structure.)
# Sizing: each app slot is 1MB. The actual firmware image is currently
# ~450KB (run `idf.py build` and check the "app partition" free-space
# line)
Type: so each 1MB slot has well over 2x headroom for growth -- 4MB

# Name: # comfortably fits two full-size slots plus everything else below with
# ~1.9MB left over unused. otadata sits between nvs and phy_init (not
# after phy_init) specifically so phy_init's own end lands back on the
# 0x10000 boundary ota_0 needs -- app-type partitions must start on a
# 64KB-aligned offset; data-type ones (nvs/phy_init/otadata/idnvs) only
# need 4KB alignment.
nvs
phy_init
otadata
ota_0
ota_1
# Device identity (serial derivation input
# provisioned once at the production station (see tools/lumtool.py) and
# read by components/devid/devid.c. Deliberately separate from the "nvs" partition
# above: FACTORY_RESET (via the admin channel) erases only "nvs"
# this one
Type: so serial/key/epoch always survive a factory reset -- and

# Name: # just as deliberately
# OTA update swapping the running app image must never touch device
# identity either.
idnvs
